title: Polypiler adapter licence audit
description: spec/adapters/<adapter>/licence-audit.yaml, written in YAML: one record per upstream file an adapter may compile, link or load, at one pinned commit of the corpus, and one entry per component the adapter needs that is not a file of that commit. 'polypiler-tooling catalog audit-adapter' checks the file against this schema and adds the rules a schema cannot state: records sorted by path and unique, every path and notice in the corpus lock, every digest equal to the imported file, a reason for every decision but usable, a restricting obligation for every blocked entry, 'model' exactly for the policy's restricted assets, and no contradiction with the licence the scanner detects.

commit.description: The pinned commit the records describe.

clearance.description: The owner's decision whether the usable entries may be fetched, linked and run; pending until an ADR records it. A refused clearance blocks every touch; a restricted asset may be touched only once it is granted.

path.description: A path relative to the repository root, '/'-separated: not absolute, no backslash, no empty, '.' or '..' segment.

licence.description: An SPDX expression; a licence SPDX does not list is LicenseRef-<name>.

origin.description: 'own' for a file written in the repository itself, or what it was converted or copied from with the notice of the pinned commit that says so.

kind.description: 'model' for weights and network descriptions, the policy's restricted assets; 'code' for everything else.

reviewer.description: The GitHub login of the person who read the file's header and the notices it rests on.

reason.description: Why the decision is what it is; required unless the decision is usable.

external.description: A component the adapter needs that is not a file of the pinned commit: a prebuilt provider or weights fetched at build or run time. Its terms are recorded here, its files are not audited.
